subject: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

Hi all — looking to lock the go/no-go for SCM v1 / Cost Model API rollout this release train.

Ask: please reply with sign-off (or blockers) by EOD today so Connor can schedule the staged rollout windows.

What we’re approving (scope):
- Cost Model API v1 “estimate” + “explain” endpoints available to Console + Optimize (behind feature flag)
- Runtime + telemetry signals required for breakdown attribution (prefill/decode split, batch_size_effective, kv_cache_hit_rate where available)
- Deterministic outputs for same inputs (version negotiation in place; v1 only for now)

Rollout proposal (high level):
1) Prod: internal tenants only (Redwood dogfood) for 24h
2) Hosted: 5% of tenants (Console cost breakdown page enabled)
3) Expand to 25% + then 100% over 5–7 days if SLOs hold
4) Optimize what-if sweep stays dark-launch until we have 1 week of stable estimates (still writing outputs but not showing recs)

What I need from each area:
- Platform (Priya): readiness + deps (telemetry/model catalog), caching strategy, feature flag behavior
- Console (Marissa): UI copy + fallback behavior confirmed (timeouts/errors shouldn’t degrade billing pages)
- SRE/Infra (Neha/Sean): risk assessment + alerting coverage + oncall playbook link
- Release (Connor): confirm train + canary windows

Key gating checks (please confirm):
- p95 latency <= 250ms for estimate endpoint, p99 <= 800ms (per SLO draft)
- Availability >= 99.9% (budgeted for dependency of Console cost breakdown, not core request path)
- Audit logging enabled for customer-level breakdown reads (security requirement)
- Cardinality controls applied to dimensions (no tenant_id in metrics labels, etc.)

Attachments:
- SCM_v1_Launch_Readiness_Checklist_2025-02-13.pdf
- SCM_v1_Rollout_Plan_2025-02-13.docx

Links:
- PM-482 (PRD sign-off tracker)
- ENG-23217 (dashboards/alerts)
- ENG-23173 (Console integration)
- INT-1041 (historical: “$0 cost breakdown” from validation failures — make sure we don’t regress)

Thanks,
Aditya
Product Lead, Optimize
Redwood Inference

---

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 11:06 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

SRE view:

I’m comfortable with the staged rollout as written, with two explicit mitigations:

1) Console dependency mode
- Console should treat SCM as “best-effort enrichment” only.
- If SCM times out (>800ms) or returns 5xx, Console should:
  a) show “Estimated cost unavailable” and
  b) not block page load for usage/billing pages.

2) Circuit breaker thresholds
- We should set client-side circuit breaking at the Console backend layer:
  - trip if error rate > 5% over 5 min or p95 > 400ms over 5 min
  - cool-down 10 min

Alerting coverage (current):
- 5xx rate (warn @ 1%, page @ 3% over 10 min)
- p95/p99 latency (warn @ 250/800, page @ 400/1200)
- saturation on upstream dependencies (telemetry query / model catalog lookup)
- mismatch detector (estimated vs metered deltas) currently set to warn-only until we have baseline

Runbook is drafted; I’ll add explicit “disable flag” steps + owners.

Sign-off from me contingent on Console confirming best-effort behavior + circuit breaker config.

— Sean
SLOs / Oncall Owner

---

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 1:22 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

Platform sign-off (with notes):

Status:
- cost-model-service deployed to prod in all regions; feature-flagged and tenant-gated
- v1 version negotiation is enforced (clients can request v1 only; unsupported => 406 w/ machine-readable error)
- deterministic calc path is locked (no randomness; dependency lookups are pinned by model version + sku)

Dependencies:
- Telemetry: we’ve implemented a “missing signal” mode (explicit assumptions + confidence degradation). Requests do not fail purely due to missing kv_cache_hit_rate, etc., but they DO fail if required routing tags (region, sku, model_id) are missing.
- Model catalog: cached locally w/ 60s TTL; hard fallback to last known good snapshot for 10 min if catalog is flaky.

Caching strategy:
- Request-level memoization for per-request repeated lookups
- Shared cache for model/sku metadata only (not tenant data)

Security/audit:
- Audit event is emitted for explain + attribution calls that include customer-level identifiers.
- We are not logging full prompts in audit events (only request ids + tenant + actor + endpoint + schema version).

Known risks:
- If region tag is missing, we currently reject; that’s correct for determinism but will look like elevated validation errors if any older runtime pods are emitting partial tags.
- Mitigation: rollout is gated to tenants already fully on the new telemetry dimension set; we can expand gating as telemetry confirms.

Given the above + SRE gating, Platform is a YES.

Priya
Platform Owner

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 3:47 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

Console sign-off, with the SRE asks accepted.

What we’re doing on Console side:
- API calls are best-effort and non-blocking to primary usage tables
- Timeout: 600ms (backend)
- Retries: none (we don’t want to amplify)
- Circuit breaker: yes — implementing Sean’s thresholds (error-rate and latency-based)
- If SCM unavailable/low confidence:
  - UI shows “Estimated cost unavailable” with a “Why?” tooltip
  - If confidence=low, we show “Low confidence estimate” + assumptions list (no scary language)

Copy:
- We’ll label as “Estimated cost (SCM v1)” and add “Estimates may differ from invoiced amounts” note
- Support macro drafted; will share with Support before we turn on 25%+

Rollout sequencing:
- I prefer dogfood + 5% tenants for at least 48h before going to 25% (assuming no incident), but OK aligning to 24h if SLOs are clean.

Net: YES from Console.

Marissa
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 13, 2025 at 5:18 PM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

Release plan proposal (pending Ava final):

- Fri 2/14 10:00 PT: enable dogfood tenants in prod (flag: scm_console_breakdown=true, allowlist)
- Mon 2/17: 5% hosted tenants (US region first), monitor 24–48h
- Wed 2/19: 25% if clean
- Fri 2/21: 100% if clean

Notes:
- We can push EU region a few days later to reduce blast radius (and because the team is thinner on EU oncall coverage next week).
- Optimize dark-launch can start alongside 25% Console, but rec display stays off as you said.

If we get a yellow signal (warning alerts sustained), we’ll hold at current % and/or disable via tenant allowlist.

Connor
Release Coordination

---

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 14, 2025 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Launch approval: Cost Model API (SCM v1) — sign-offs + rollout plan

Approved to proceed with the rollout plan.

Conditions:
- Keep Console best-effort/non-blocking as committed.
- If we see any impact to usage/billing page load times or elevated error rates, we pause at current stage and disable for affected tenants.
- Please send me a 1-pager after the first 24h of dogfood with: availability, p95/p99 latency, error rate, and top validation errors.

Thanks for keeping the scope tight and auditable.

Ava
Executive Sponsor
Redwood Inference
